description: Experience a tranquil, private getaway just 5 minutes from downtown Rincón and only 10 minutes from the area’s best surf spots and paradise beaches. This charming 40-foot converted trailer has been thoughtfully transformed into a cozy, stationary home with a spacious 20×12 wooden deck, surrounded by bamboo and fruit trees. Tropical birds and lush greenery create a calm, immersive setting—perfect for slowing down, reading in a hammock, and reconnecting with nature.The spaceThe spaceThe rental includes a fully equipped kitchen, a quiet and efficient new AC unit in the bedroom that cools the entire space, a generous refrigerator and freezer capacity, and an in-unit washer and dryer for added convenience.Sleeping arrangementsThe full-size bed comfortably accommodates two guests and is set up with two firm pillows and two softer pillows to suit different sleep preferences.For remote workersStay connected with Starlink internet, offering fast and reliable service throughout your stay. The space includes a dedicated workspace, backup power, and an external monitor with an HDMI connection, making it especially convenient for remote work or extended stays.Ideal for both short-term visits and longer stays, this peaceful retreat offers privacy, comfort, and easy access to everything Rincón has to offer.

description: Modern, street level, spacious one bedroom apartment in Puntas area of Rincon, PR. Unit is on dead-end street, with family oriented housing, and ocean view. Off-street parking, fast reliable internet, 2 large screen TVs, 2 AC units, washer/dryer, stove, microwave, grill, 1+1/2 baths, indoor/outdoor dining areas, queen bed and futon, and remote work space. Solar panels back up during power outages. We maintain refreshments at cost. Minimum 7 day rental. Discount for monthly rental.The spaceThis is a very large (1480 sq ft) condo, five minutes from numerous restaurants, beaches, and water activities including surfing, paddle boards, snorkel and scuba diving. Fast reliable internet and work space with printer and large flat screen display is ideal for remote work. Tesla battery and solar array provides reliable power. Large grocery store is 10 minutes by car. Very quiet and stocked with a range of refreshments at cost for your convenience. Unit is handicapped accessible. This is not a ‘Party House’ as neighbors and a lower level renter are close. Quiet is expected after 9pm; if not adhered to, you will be asked to leave! Maximum occupancy is two adults unless cleared beforehand. Violators will be asked to leave.Questions? Hosts are bilingual.Guest accessThe entire unit is available. The rear balcony includes a hammock and washer/dryer. The hammock has proved very relaxing for the afternoon nap. The kitchen is fully equipped. The living area includes a large screen TV with U-tube, Pandora, Netflix, Amazon Prime and over-the-air ABC from New York as well as local Spanish programming. A DVD player can be used with a selection of DVDs. A propane grill is located on the front patio. Reliable wireless internet is present. With your laptop, we supply a printer and flat screen display. The front patio provides an outdoor, in addition to the indoor, dining area. For those warm days, the unit is equipped with two AC units as well as three ceiling fans. In the event of extended utility problems, there is a generator and auxiliary water supply. For arrivals, the unit is accessed by a lockbox for entrance keys.Other things to noteUnit is approximately 35 minutes from Aquadilla airport (BQN) which is served by Frontier, Jet Blue, and United airlines. From San Juan airport (SJU), either rent car or fly to Mayaquez (MAZ) via Cape Air and rent a car. A car is essential as there is only rare public transportation in Rincon area. Driving directions from airport are available if needed. We are located about 2.5 hours by car from SJU and 20 minutes from MAZ.

description: Nestled away in the mountains you’ll find a tranquil, rustic mountain hideaway with breathtaking sunrise views and epic sunsets! Enjoy tropical outdoor common areas, cool off in a luxurious pool equipped with waterfall massage and enjoy alone time. If it’s fitness you seek, indulge in a workout on the common deck or make use of the air conditioned fitness room. New in 2024 will be an onsite wellness center providing services such as massage, yoga and counseling. Inquire upon booking!The spaceLocated on the corner of Puerto Rico’s pristine west coast, Porta Del Sol, Rincón has everything a well seasoned traveler could expect—from nature’s finest beaches for surf and swim to world class gastronomy. Rincón is a hidden gem with all the beauty and authenticity of la isla del encanto, Puerto Rico!Nestled away in the mountains of Rio Grande, you’ll find The Terraces at Rincón, a tranquil, rustic, private and centrally located mountain hideaway with breathtaking sunrise views over Mount Atalaya, and epic sunsets overlooking the Caribbean Sea and Atlantic Ocean. The Terraces at Rincón is minutes away from world famous beaches, restaurants and attractions, while being tucked away in a peaceful residential community, providing you with a memorable hometown tropical experience. Stylishly designed with comfort in mind, each suite is uniquely equipped with exceptional features and furnishings to enhance your relaxation experience. Our villas feature fully equipped kitchens, smart TVs, air conditioning bedrooms and outdoor terraces perfect for sunbathing or al fresco dining. The Terraces at Rincon offers lush and tropical outdoor common areas. Cool off in a luxurious pool with waterfall massage and enjoy alone time counting the shooting stars under the Caribbean moon on the rooftop mirador. If it’s fitness you seek, indulge in a workout on the common deck or make use of the air conditioned fitness room.The Terraces at Rincón has everything you require to have an enhanced tropical relaxation experience. The suites are ideal for weekend getaways, weekly or monthly rentals, long term stays, corporate rentals, remote workers and for corporate and wellness retreats.Guest accessGuests are welcome in all common areas including pool and fitness room and BBQ grill unless otherwise specified.Shared Laundry Room is available 24 hours.Other things to noteOther accommodations or full guest house, 7 bedrooms in total, are available for reservation. Property is ideal for retreats, small corporate meetings, intimate weddings or family gatherings.

title: Rincon Downtown Plaza 2BR Oasis Sun, Fun & Surf
description: Stay in the heart of Rincon, PR, in our 2BR apartment overlooking the vibrant town plaza. Immerse in the local culture right from your balcony, and don't miss the lively Artwalk every Thursday night. Steps from delicious cuisine, unique shops, and lively bars. A short drive leads you to stunning beaches and the best surf spots PR has to offer. Experience Rincon at its best! This unit does not have a backup generator or cistern. please read all additional notes in description prior to booking.The space2 bedroom with balcony overlooking the vibrant town plaza.Guest accessAccess to entire 2nd floorOther things to notePlease note that the Airbnb is located in Puerto Rico. As we are on an island, utilities such as electricity, water, and Wi-Fi can occasionally be interrupted without notice. Unlike the mainland, utility disruptions here may take several days to resolve. If you require reliable internet access for work during your stay, we strongly recommend bringing your own mobile hotspot and a back up power source, as uninterrupted service cannot be guaranteed.

title: La Pina Private Retreat | Entire Boutique Hotel
description: Perfect for family gatherings, retreats, intimate weddings, wellness escapes, and group getaways, the property has been thoughtfully refreshed with enhanced Wi-Fi, curated décor, and renewed attention to every detail. Guests enjoy private outdoor soaking tubs, rainfall showers, rooftop sunset decks with fire pits, a pool, BBQ patio, and inviting indoor-outdoor living spaces throughout the hotel. La Piña offers easy access to local beaches, restaurants, shops, and the historic town plaza.The space**THIS LISTING IS FOR THE ENTIRE HOTEL, ALL TO YOURSELVES** This property is gated and is extremely private. Tucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña, including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, an outdoor kitchen and BBQ, and our favorite feature, the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella, and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) The La Piña Suite includes a complete kitchen with a gas-burning stove/oven with flat top griddle, microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. All other suites include a complete kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), electric hot plate, and all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. The laundry room is free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the foot wash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting in the pool. All kitchens are equipped with cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink and a large first aid kit is located in the laundry mounted on the wall by the door.
